text_block_list.text:
At the suggestion of Satono Crown, who said she hadn't been feeling well lately,
we went on a walk to clear her head.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuugh...!
The view from here really is the best, isn't it?
It reminds me of the old days.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You get a panoramic view of the city from here, right?
The way it sits among the mountains... kind of reminds me of Hong Kong.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There were quite a few small hills around.
I remember often looking out over the town from the hills nearby.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at it like this soothes me.
...The evening sky is so pretty it brings tears to my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
…………
I haven't gone there in quite a while...
...It must be a wonderful place.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please forgive my rudeness.
I couldn't help but overhear your conversation.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No... thank you very much.
For calling it lovely.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
This might sound subjective, but...
Crown-san's words just made me
remember my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I come here from time to time too. Germany has quite a lot of mountains as well, you see...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Are you also... reminiscing about your hometown here, Flash-san?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
However, I'm not merely reminiscing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To refresh my spirit.
That is why I come here.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "Someday, having become an even more splendid being, she would set foot upon her homeland once more..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Every time I look upon this scenery,
I find myself renewing that very resolve.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: With a refreshed mindset...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Would you mind if I took in
this view for just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I don't want this view to end up
as just another nostalgic memory."
choice_data_list: I'll wait as long as you need.

text_block_list.text: After that, the two of us gazed at the scenery for a while—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It has completely turned into evening, hasn't it? The sun is sinking so low.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The sunset here is beautiful too... But—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I don't have any time to waste shedding tears.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head back!
So that you and I can start dashing toward tomorrow.

Perhaps thanks to the refreshing break,
Satono Crown's condition improved.
After that, the two of us gazed at the scenery for a while—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...It's no good.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The more I look at it... the more nostalgic I get...
I'm sorry, let's head back now.

It seems
I wasn't able to properly refresh myself.
